defects.source_says: Provision 1-101 amends section 1-101 of EO 12201 'to read as follows', inserting an authorization that 'is revoked as of October 31,1980'. Under the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling a restated clause 'continues, amended, until the parent order ends', and the other amending orders in this batch (EO 10098, 12397, 12447) are treated as continuing with the clause they rewrote. On that method the text this order wrote operated at least until October 31, 1980, after the claimed whole-order end of August 11, 1980; the claim neither adopts nor discloses October 31, 1980 as a candidate end.

defects.claim_says: Provision 1-104 is 'exhausted by performance on 1980-07-28'; 'the amended definition survives as part of Executive Order No. 12201'.
defects.source_says: 1-104 restates section 1-105 of EO 12201 'to read as follows'. Under the strike-and-insert ruling it continues with the parent, and no held text ends EO 12201: a cruden number search for EO:12201 finds only EO 12201 itself and EO 12225. The end of this clause is therefore not established by the sources cited, and the claim states an exhausted-on-performance end that the batch's ruled method does not support.
